reason: It's close to my masjid and I can actually feel the fabric and try it on, which is the only way I buy now. I would stop by after Friday prayer and probably pick up the 2 abayas for $80 or a hijab, but only if the crepe isn't thin.
objection: Is the crepe see-through or scratchy once I'm in it? A name on the tag doesn't tell me how it feels or if it'll pill after a few washes. And $75 to $80 for a thobe is a lot for me when it's not Eid yet.
would_change_my_mind: If I touch it and the fabric feels thin or cheap, I walk out, even with the 15% off.
